title: (Pwn2Own) Samsung Galaxy S25 Samsung Account Open Redirect Security Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass security on affected installations of Samsung Galaxy S25. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Samsung Account application. An attacker can force a redirection to a site that serves malicious content. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to start arbitrary Android exported activites.
